name: WTI/Brent Spread & Natural Gas Term Structure
description: Two-part commodity futures research: (1) WTI/Brent crude oil spread analysis with rolling mean/std bands, distribution, and summary stats; (2) Natural gas term structure analysis showing current vs 1Y ago curve shape, M1-M2 roll spread evolution, and contango/backwardation regime classification.
source:
# =============================================================================
# WTI/BRENT SPREAD & NATURAL GAS TERM STRUCTURE
# =============================================================================
# Part 1: WTI minus Brent spread with rolling 252d mean/std bands, histogram,
#          and summary stats (current, mean, std, z-score, min, max)
# Part 2: NG term structure (M1-M4, M6) current vs 1Y ago, M1-M2 roll spread
#          over time, and summary stats with regime classification
# =============================================================================

# =============================================
# DATA SOURCES
# =============================================

# Primary: NG futures from market_data_source (for spread_depth term structure)
src = market_data_source()()

# NG continuation — NoAdjustment for absolute price levels
# Multiple calls with different spread_depth to reconstruct deferred months
ng_s1 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=1)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
ng_s2 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=2)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
ng_s3 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=3)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
ng_s5 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=5)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# NG contract prices: M1 is front, deferred = M1 - spread
ng_m1 = ng_s1.c
ng_m2 = ng_m1 - ng_s1.spread
ng_m3 = ng_m1 - ng_s2.spread
ng_m4 = ng_m1 - ng_s3.spread
ng_m6 = ng_m1 - ng_s5.spread

# 1 Year Ago NG prices (252 trading days)
ng_m1_1y = ng_m1 >> 252
ng_m2_1y = ng_m2 >> 252
ng_m3_1y = ng_m3 >> 252
ng_m4_1y = ng_m4 >> 252
ng_m6_1y = ng_m6 >> 252

# CL (WTI) via reference_futures + futures_continuation
cl_ref = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(cl_ref.o, cl_ref.h, cl_ref.l, cl_ref.c, cl_ref.v, cl_ref.vw, cl_ref.n)
cl_close = ffill(cl_cont.c)

# SC (Brent) via reference_futures + futures_continuation
sc_ref = reference_futures(ticker='SC')()
sc_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(sc_ref.o, sc_ref.h, sc_ref.l, sc_ref.c, sc_ref.v, sc_ref.vw, sc_ref.n)
brent_close = ffill(sc_cont.c)

# =============================================
# PART 1: WTI/BRENT SPREAD CALCULATIONS
# =============================================

# WTI minus Brent spread
wb_spread = cl_close - brent_close

# Rolling 252-day (1Y) statistics
wb_mean = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(wb_spread)
wb_std = stddev(period=252)(wb_spread)
wb_upper = wb_mean + wb_std
wb_lower = wb_mean - wb_std
wb_zscore = zscore(window=252)(wb_spread)

# Split spread into positive/negative for dual-color area fill
wb_pos = wb_spread if wb_spread > 0 else 0.0 / 0.0
wb_neg = wb_spread if wb_spread < 0 else 0.0 / 0.0

bar_ts = index()

# =============================================
# PART 1 REPORTERS
# =============================================

# Chart 1: WTI/Brent Spread Over Time with rolling bands
xy_lines(
    title='WTI/Brent Spread: Where Premium Lies',
    category='1. WTI/Brent Spread',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='Spread ($/bbl): WTI minus Brent',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI Premium', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Brent Premium', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d Mean', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='+1 Std Dev', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='-1 Std Dev', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, wb_pos, wb_neg, wb_mean, wb_upper, wb_lower)

# Chart 2: WTI/Brent Spread Distribution
histogram(
    title='WTI/Brent Spread Distribution',
    category='1. WTI/Brent Spread',
    bins=40,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_label='Spread ($/bbl)',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    order=2
)(wb_spread)

# Chart 3: Summary Stats Table
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='WTI/Brent Spread Summary',
        row_size=6,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Current Spread', '1Y Mean', '1Y Std Dev', 'Current Z-Score', 'All-Time Min', 'All-Time Max'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Mean', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Std', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min', grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max', grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. WTI/Brent Spread',
    order=3
)(wb_spread, wb_mean, wb_std, wb_zscore, wb_spread, wb_spread)

# =============================================
# PART 2: NATURAL GAS TERM STRUCTURE
# =============================================

# M1-M2 roll spread
ng_m1m2_spread = ng_s1.spread

# Split for dual-color area
ng_spread_pos = ng_m1m2_spread if ng_m1m2_spread > 0 else 0.0 / 0.0
ng_spread_neg = ng_m1m2_spread if ng_m1m2_spread < 0 else 0.0 / 0.0

# =============================================
# PART 2 REPORTERS
# =============================================

# Chart 4: NG Term Structure — Current vs 1 Year Ago
labeled_lines(
    title='Natural Gas Term Structure',
    category='2. NG Term Structure',
    y_axis_label='Price ($/MMBtu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    smooth=True,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['M1', 'M2', 'M3', 'M4', 'M6'],
        series=[
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Current', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='1 Year Ago', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, marker=MarkerSymbol.SquareMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last)
        ]
    ),
    order=1
)(ng_m1, ng_m2, ng_m3, ng_m4, ng_m6, ng_m1_1y, ng_m2_1y, ng_m3_1y, ng_m4_1y, ng_m6_1y)

# Chart 5: M1-M2 Roll Spread Over Time
xy_lines(
    title='NG Front Spread: Backwardation vs Contango',
    category='2. NG Term Structure',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='M1 minus M2 ($/MMBtu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation (M1 > M2)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango (M1 < M2)', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, ng_spread_pos, ng_spread_neg)

# Chart 6: NG Summary Stats Table
# Current M1-M2 spread and 1Y ago spread
ng_m1m2_1y = ng_m1m2_spread >> 252

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Natural Gas Term Structure Summary',
        row_size=7,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['M1 Price', 'M2 Price', 'M3 Price', 'M4 Price', 'M6 Price', 'M1-M2 Spread (Current)', 'M1-M2 Spread (1Y Ago)'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='M1', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='M2', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='M3', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='M4', grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='M6', grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Spread Now', grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Spread 1Y', grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. NG Term Structure',
    order=3
)(ng_m1, ng_m2, ng_m3, ng_m4, ng_m6, ng_m1m2_spread, ng_m1m2_1y)
